full_page.content:
1933, December
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original notes by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey OFM Cap.
(his notebook No. 6)
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 1
WANTED
Dec. 17 Girl - German, Catholic - $2.00 per week - to be as home - (parents & 2 child'n) R.J. Mueller - 4941 Ashley - phone Tuxedo 22814
1934, January
Jan. 4 Mrs. A. Tetreault - 1929 Collingwood - phone Townsend 65905 - girl or lady for caring for family during confinement. Anna Nernberg - Poor $5.00
Page 2 Blank Page
1935, June
Page 3
June 4 James Mahaffy - 7 - most fearfully burned two yrs. last March 27 ('33) had over thirty blood-transfusions. No doctor would give any hope. Was prayed for here and enrolled repeatedly in S.M.A. After innumer- able skin-graftings comes to Monastery To-day can walk without crutches Deo. Gr.
Florence Watson - 25 - recovering from T.B. after more than a dozen operations. Last operation on spine for three days has not been re- taining any food.
Mrs. M. Mason - 53 - slight stroke - has husband & 3 children ... Enrol- led two weeks ago- now improving but still far from well.
Novenas Dorothy Young - 26 - operation - To-day - like sinus
Emma Noblestarr - 30 - terrible operation last Monday ... use of arm lost so far - cancer feared.
Page 4 June 5 Edw'd Collins - 12 - worse . . .
Easter
5 Florence Reno - 55 -
